architectureDecisions: D1 — createExharnessMcpVerifyServer({ worktreeRoot, verifiers, status, tools }) returns { start({ stdin, stdout }), stop(), tools }. verifiers: non-empty [{ name, verify }] (createLocalCommandVerifier; verify({ candidate }) -> { claim, status, evidence, summary }). status defaults { attemptIndex: 0, candidateSha: null, lastVerification: null }. tools defaults ['exharness_verify','exharness_status']; any other name or /promote|accept|merge/i throws TypeError code MCP_FORBIDDEN_TOOL. Return tools is Object.freeze of those two. Exports: createExharnessMcpVerifyServer, MCP_PROTOCOL_VERSION ('2025-03-26'), MCP_FORBIDDEN_TOOL, MCP_SERVER_INFO ({ name: 'exharness-verify', version: '1.0.0' }), EXHARNESS_MCP_TOOLS ({ VERIFY: 'exharness_verify', STATUS: 'exharness_status' }).

D2 — NDJSON JSON-RPC 2.0 (no Content-Length). initialize -> { protocolVersion: '2025-03-26', capabilities: { tools: {} }, serverInfo: MCP_SERVER_INFO }. notifications/initialized: no reply. tools/list: VERIFY then STATUS, each inputSchema { type: 'object', properties: {}, additionalProperties: false }. tools/call exharness_verify -> { content: [{ type: 'text', text: JSON.stringify({ ok, results: [{ name, status, reason }] }) }], isError: false } with ok iff every status==='PASS'. tools/call exharness_status -> same envelope, payload { attemptIndex, candidateSha, lastVerification }. Unknown method/tool (incl. exharness_promote) -32601; parse -32700; invalid -32600. ping may reply {}.

D3 — Zero runtime deps: node built-ins + runProcess + createLocalCommandVerifier (CLI path). No @modelcontextprotocol/server import; no package.json dependencies field. Tests: fake-mcp-client.mjs on a stdin/stdout pair. CLI: when this module is the process entry, --worktree <abs> --verifiers <json [{name,command,args,timeoutMs}]>, claim=`agent-task.${name}`, requireUnchangedTree true, start on process.stdin/stdout; missing args exit 64. No new bin.

D4 — Discovery pin: supervisor-owned stdio pair; live CLI auto-discovery out of scope (no ~/.codex/.kiro/.gemini, no project .codex/config.toml, no EXHARNESS_MCP_FD, no adapter argv change). mcpVerify=false after invocationObserver. false/null/undefined: off (call site inside truthy mcpVerify branch). true: on, internal PassThrough pair. { stdin, stdout }: on, those streams. Else TypeError 'mcpVerify must be false, true, or { stdin, stdout }'. When on: createExharnessMcpVerifyServer({ worktreeRoot: workspace.root, verifiers, status: mcpStatus }) with mcpStatus={ attemptIndex: 0, candidateSha: task.baseRevision, lastVerification: null }, await start; finally stop then dispose then rm. createSupervisedAgentStrategy({ ..., statusSink=null }); when a function, after ACT and after verifiers: statusSink({ attemptIndex, candidateSha, lastVerification }) into mcpStatus. invocationObserver default and payload unchanged; no AGENT_SUPERVISED_RESULT_V1 fields added; no node:net/listen.

D5 — exharness_verify: HEAD via runProcess('git',['rev-parse','HEAD'],{ cwd: worktreeRoot, env:{ GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM:'1' }, timeoutMs: 120000 }); verifier.verify({ candidate:{ id:'mcp-verify', version: head } }); name from verifier.name; status from artifact.status; reason from evidence :reason= (else artifact.status).
